visual.general_description: H&E-stained microscopy field showing nests of small round dark cells separated by pink stroma.
visual.detailed_description: Color photomicrograph of a pink-and-purple stained tissue section. Several rounded nests of densely packed small dark-purple cells, each with scattered slit-like clear spaces, lie separated by pink fibrous stroma containing sparse scattered cells. One large round nest occupies the center-right and smaller nests surround it. A white scale bar with tiny unreadable text is at the lower right. No panel letters, arrows or other labels are visible.
